measurement: GII = t2 - t1 in minutes; time to OD595 = 0.2 with cell-free supernatant versus fresh medium only.
source_inhibition_criterion: GII > 300 min; no new classification or significance test in this panel.
old_mapping: TwoSlopeNorm(-400, 0, 1000); negative minute slope 1/800, positive 1/2000. The inverse is valid but the quantitative slopes differ.
adopted_mapping: Normalize(-400, 1000); u = (x + 400)/1400, inverse x = -400 + 1400u. Bounds round outward around the complete source range; all negative values are retained.
comparison_limit: Shared numeric range does not create equal physical bar-length scaling.
classification_limit: Positive GII indicates delay; negative indicates earlier attainment and does not establish statistically significant growth promotion.
independent_numeric_scope: Independent reviewer recomputed all displayed matches, means and ranks from the complete source and read the primary PDF. Maximum mean rounding difference: 2.84e-14.
palette_limit: Linear normalization does not certify perceptual uniformity or publication acceptance.
